preconditions.description: The number of brains n must be between 2 and 200000.
The length of the parent list p must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: Each parent brain index must be valid and less than the current brain index.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n - 1 space-separated numbers.
All output numbers must be non-negative integers representing brain latencies.
The output must match the computed brain latencies after each brain is added.
